fig1_energy_two_ways.svg: Energy of a parallel-plate capacitor versus gap d at fixed voltage. The charge picture (1/2)CV^2 (line, from capacitance_parallel_plate) matches the field-energy integral eps0/2 of |E|^2 over the gap (markers, from field_energy); both rise as 1/d as the plates close.
fig2_capacitance_geometry.svg: Capacitance of a spherical capacitor (inner radius a, outer b) normalized to the isolated-sphere value, from capacitance_spherical and capacitance_isolated_sphere. A tight gap (b/a near 1) gives large C; as b/a grows the outer shell stops mattering and C approaches the isolated-sphere limit 4 pi eps0 a.
